prompt:
Create exactly one high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp for “Flacier Rules”, shown as a clean 1440 × 900 landscape first viewport with no browser chrome. This is the category-standard baseline for a personal proxy routing rule tool: deliberately conventional, calm, highly usable, and very well made — not a parody and not a marketing landing page.

STRUCTURE AND HIERARCHY, TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. A compact 64px white top navigation with a small restrained blue geometric “F” mark, wordmark “Flacier Rules”, standard nav links “规则”, “URL 测试”, “订阅导入”, “转换”, and a quiet outlined “GitHub” button at the far right. Thin bottom border.
2. A centered content container about 1180px wide. A modest page title, not oversized: “个人分流规则与订阅工具”. Under it, one concise factual sentence: “测试 URL 命中的规则，生成客户端导入链接。数据只在浏览器中处理。” The title area should occupy little vertical space.
3. Main work area is a practical two-column layout, roughly 65/35. The wider left column contains two stacked bordered panels; the right column contains a rules catalog panel. Panels use white surfaces, thin cool-grey borders, 8–10px corner radius, almost no shadow.
4. First left panel is titled “URL 测试”. Show a standard URL input containing exactly “https://api.openai.com/v1/models” and a solid blue button “测试 URL”. Directly below, show a clear successful route result as the visual focal point: a horizontal route line “api.openai.com  →  AI.list  →  AI  →  美国节点”. Also show a compact definition grid with labels and values: “命中规则  api.openai.com”, “规则集  AI.list”, “策略  AI”, “默认选择  美国节点”. Use a subtle pale-blue result background and one small check icon from a consistent line-icon set.
5. Second left panel is titled “订阅导入”. Show two ordinary labeled fields: “订阅地址” with placeholder “https://example.com/subscription”, and “配置名称” containing “Flacier Personal”; then one blue button “生成导入链接”. Beneath, include the factual privacy note “订阅地址仅在浏览器中处理。” Then display compact neutral client labels, all visible and spelled exactly: “Mihomo”, “sing-box”, “Surge”, “Stash”, “Shadowrocket”, “Loon”, “Quantumult X”. They should look like understated segmented labels or small outlined tabs, not colorful badges.
6. Right panel is titled “规则列表” with a small text link “查看全部”. Show a dense but readable table/list with columns “规则集” and “策略”: “OpenAI / AI.list / AI”, “Claude / AI.list / AI”, “Developer / developer.list / DEV”, “Steam / steam.list / STEAM”, “Discord / discord.list / DISCORD”, “Media / media.list / MEDIA”, and “Social / social.list / SOCIAL”. Use dividers and aligned monospace only for filenames and policy codes. At the panel bottom, show a restrained file link “manifest.yaml”.

VISUAL SYSTEM:
- White and very light cool-grey ground (#F6F8FB), white panels, dark navy text (#102A43), medium cool-grey secondary text, one accessible blue accent close to #2563EB, thin borders close to #D7DFE8.
- Use a familiar product UI sans-serif character similar to Inter or SF Pro; medium weights, compact type scale, crisp labels, tabular alignment. Monospace appears only for URL/file/code values.
- Standard 8px spacing rhythm, 40–48px content padding, restrained 8–10px radii, clear focus and button states suggested through realistic UI finish.
- Design for scanning and operation. The URL route result must be the strongest visual element, while every other region remains quiet and useful.
- Pixel-sharp screenshot-like interface rendering, realistic spacing and alignment, fully readable Simplified Chinese and exact English client labels.

DO NOT INCLUDE: orange anywhere; gradients or gradient blobs; glassmorphism or decorative blur; cyberpunk, terminal cosplay, neon, dark theme, noisy textures, 3D art, illustrations, photos, emoji, giant marketing typography, sales claims, testimonials, fake user metrics, rule-count metrics, speed claims, invented capabilities, pricing, decorative dashboard charts, bento-card clutter, excessive pill shapes, heavy shadows, thick outlines, oversized empty hero space, or any text suggesting cross-format subscription conversion exists. Do not add any extra sections or promotional copy. Keep the frame as an honest, conventional developer-tool baseline executed with excellent hierarchy and craft.
